steps.text: Monday

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Agh... Look at the time... Who's knocking on my door this early in the morning...?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Coming, coming. Just a moment.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Sorry to bother you, Orchid.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You are...?

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: My name is Jerry. One of my... relations, is a patient aboard the ship.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Hello, Jerry. Do you need something from me?

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: A wedding dress! I would like to ask you to make a wedding dress! Please, I beg you!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You want me to make a wedding dress? I'm afraid you're asking the wrong person. I just edited a fashion magazine.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Besides, we'll be stopping at a city for resupplies next month. You can visit a high-end tailor shop while we're there.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: But Dr. Warfarin said that Penny might not make it through the month... We probably can't wait till then.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'm sorry to hear that. I didn't know.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: I realize I probably sound pushy, but you're the only one I can turn to.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Are you really sure about this? I do know a thing or two about fashion design, but I'm not a professional designer. The wedding dress might not be exactly what you're looking for.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Besides, we don't have a very wide variety of fabric onboard. I'll be limited in what I can use to design your dress, and it may not come out looking perfect.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Right, I understand. We don't have any wild expectations. Penny and I will be more than happy just to get a decent enough wedding dress.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: *Sigh*, if you really don't mind, I can help you with this.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: May I see Penny, then? I need to take her measurements before I work.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Considering Penny's situation... I guess we could, if you'll just be measuring.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Will tomorrow work?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Yes. Remember to send me the room number. I'll be there at 2 P.M. sharp.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Thank you, Orchid.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Alright, now go back and stay with your fiancée.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: See you tomorrow.
Tuesday
Rhodes Island Hospital Room

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Alright, good job. That wraps it up with the measurements. Now, let's help you lie down. Slowly.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: Thank you very much, Orchid. *Cough*. He went straight to you without telling me anything.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Don't worry about it. It's the least I can do. You're looking pretty good. I can see that he takes care of you.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: Right, ever since I got sick, things have been as difficult on him as they have been on me. I know how taxing it must be to keep taking care of me like he does.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: No, not at all, Penny. I'm not tired!

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: Jerry, could you bring me a bowl of vegetable soup from the cafeteria? I'm really craving some right now.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Yes, of course. I'll be right back!

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: Jerry, slow down... Uh, never mind.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: Orchid, let's talk more about the wedding dress, *cough*...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Right, I brought some catalogs with me. Take a look and see if there's anything in here that you like.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: They're gorgeous, and extravagant... Did you design all these?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Of course not. They're classics by famous designers from all over the world. I can make a dress for you based on these styles.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: But I want to see your own designs. May I?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Sorry, Penny. Jerry might not have told you, but I was just the editor of a fashion magazine. I don't have any designs of my own to show.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: But I touched the callus on your purlicue just now. Calluses this thick only come from the big scissors that tailors use.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You've got an eye for detail, Penny.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I did work in design before, but I didn't do a very good job at it. That's why I chose to leave that line of work in the end.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: No way. You have very good taste.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Design calls for more than good taste.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Back when I was still in fashion school, my instructor Boyd once told me that my work lacked spirit. He suggested I find another career, said my lack of spirit would only be a waste of a life.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: He didn't mean my life, but the collective lives of my customers.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: He sounds like a spiteful man who can't hold his tongue. *Cough*. You shouldn't have let him get to you.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Absolutely. He's an annoying man, but he's also one of Columbia's most famous designers. I really respected him at the time.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That's why I had a breakdown. I couldn't keep at it anymore, so I submitted the paperwork to change my major to art history.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: And you were really okay with that?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That's not important, Penny.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: *cough*, to tell you the truth, I really am not worried about you wasting my life.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: So why don't you give it a try?

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It takes a lot more time to design a wedding dress than normal clothing. If something gets in my way, it might hold up your wedding.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: I'm sorry if I'm being difficult, Orchid, but please think of it as my dying wish.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: *Sigh*, fine. I'll make you a wedding dress, one for you and you alone.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: So please forget what that old man said to you all those years ago, *cough*.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Alright, can we talk more tomorrow, no, the next couple of days? I need to learn more about you and your fiancé too.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: Of course. There's no hurry. You... *cough* *cough*... you can come talk to me anytime.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Okay, then. I'll work on a rough design based on your specs. Once I'm done with that, I'll come talk to you before I finalize it. Try to get some rest now.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: *Cough*... See you.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Alright. There's our rough design. Let's see...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: *Sigh*... This girl is way too thin. She's practically a skeleton. I'll have to give her some puffier sleeves and skirt to make her look less skinny.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Oh, darling, which material should we use? Organza? Chiffon? Maybe satin...?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Inspiration... Where are you when I need you the most?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (Picks up the wooden puppets on the table and knocks them together lightly)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: *Sigh*... What's your story anyway?
Wednesday

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Penny and I met in Siesta. There's a really famous beach there with milk white sand. Uh, at the time, I was getting drinks for me and the boys, and my eyes landed on her when I turned around.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: It was crowded, but I noticed her right away. The setting sun was slowly sinking into the sea, dying its waters yellow, and the sky...

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: The sky was pink. It was magnificent and beautiful. Everyone at the beach was gasping in awe or taking pictures, but not me.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: I just kept looking at her.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Siesta... What is Siesta like? Maybe I should give Ceylon a call.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Hello, Ceylon? Sorry for calling you at this hour.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: So, I remember you're from Siesta.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: No, nothing happened. I just wanted to ask if you had any pictures or videos of the Siestan seascape that I could use as a reference.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Okay, thank you. I'll come pick it up tomorrow.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Thanks.
Thursday.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: *Cough*, someone had just thrown beer in my face... I turned around and found a giddy boy giggling at me. I could only smile back awkwardly. Then... *cough*... what happened next was really weird.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: He came up to me and asked if I wanted to see some hydrangeas.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: *Cough*... I've had guys hit on me with worse pick-up lines, and he was stammering all the way...

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: Hnn—But I took him up on it.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: We visited the most beautiful garden I'd ever seen. There were these small balls of flowers packed together. All of which he cared for himself... *cough*.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: Up until then, I had never seen so many colorful hydrangeas.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Sorry, Lena, but would it be okay if I come pick some hydrangeas at your greenhouse this weekend?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Sorry, Orchid, but I'm running low on hydrangeas this month, and I need them for my perfumes... Mind if I ask what you need them for?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Do you know about Penny at the ICU?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: She and her fiancé are getting married in her room this weekend. You know what bad shape she's in. There's only so much we can do with the venue, but I want to try to decorate it as best I can.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Oh, that girl? It's true, things aren't looking very bright for her. She might... Never mind. Can you come fetch them tomorrow?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Of course. Will eight o'clock in the evening do?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Of course. You should take care of yourself too and get some rest. You don't seem very well lately.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You're right... design work is exhausting... Anyway, thank you, Lena.
Friday

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: She told you about the hydrangeas, right? She probably told you about the scissors, too.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: A lot of people think my hobbies, gardening and papercutting, are a little... how should I say this... unmanly, right.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: But Penny doesn't think so. She actually likes them. Sometimes we sit in the garden together for a whole day just cutting a single piece of paper into different shapes.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: She's very good at it. Not so clumsy like me.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Sorry, Orchid. I caught a cold a couple days ago. If it wasn't for that, I would've helped you out.

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Here are the laces you asked for. I got them from back home. They're all handmade and easy on the skin. Not too prickly.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: They feel very different to the touch. Thanks.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Oh, right, I have a question I want to ask you. Let's say I wanted to add some elements of papercutting to the design. How would you trim the dress?

steps.name: Bibeak
steps.text: Do you have a design drawing? Let me see...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Here you go. Thanks for your help.
Saturday

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: *Cough*... Jerry sold the house to pay for my treatment...

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: I wonder... how the garden is doing... *cough*. Without anyone taking care of the flowers, they probably all withered.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: The days we spent cutting paper together... were quiet and carefree. Too bad... those days are behind us...

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: Back then... we would even play games... *cough*...

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: *Cough*... Jerry didn't know how to play very well, so I helped him...

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: What a dummy I was... *cough*... Who'll play with him now...?

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: (Why did I accept his proposal...?)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: The hydrangea patch on the chest... there we go. Sew it on... perfect.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: The dip dyed skirt... Hm... is this too light of a shade? Let me take a look from a little farther away.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: No, this is just the right shade of blue.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Man, this skirt looks just like a hollowed-out papercutting. Bibeak's a genius.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Okay, darling... I'm quite fond of you.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I hope Penny will like you, too.
Monday

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Right now, slowly...

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: Thank you, Orchid.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Phew... Okay. It's a good thing I made it with buttons up front instead of fastening in the back.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: It's beautiful... Thank you. Just looking at it... it brings back so many memories.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: (Fondles the dress feebly)

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: I love it... Thank you, Orchid. You seem... exhausted.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: Thank you... so much.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Don't mention it. After you try it on today, I'll bring it back and work on the collar with some laces. It'll be finished soon.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Tomorrow, you'll wear it and marry Jerry.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: That's great... but I'm sorry. I can't... I can't wear it.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Don't be silly. This dress was made for you and for that moment.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Tomorrow, with everyone's blessings, Jerry and you will become husband and wife while you wear this dress.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You'll have a champagne tower, a balloon arch, and cookies all day long. When everyone walks past you tomorrow, they'll gasp in admiration: Oh, what a beautiful bride.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: I'm sorry, Orchid...

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: Right from the start, I never expected you to finish it... I thought that... I wouldn't have to turn him down again if you didn't finish.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: I turned him down... so many times. I couldn't bring myself to do it again.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: What you said is so beautiful... If only we could bring everything to a stop then... but I... I can't be so selfish.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: I... I'm very thankful for your work, but please... please don't finish this dress. I can't marry him... I can't.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I know how you feel. All brides feel like this before a wedding.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But you can't back down in the face of those emotions. You two love each other deeply, don't you?

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: This isn't backing down...

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: Orchid... I love papercutting... but... I don't like making the final snip.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: If I mess it up... It can't be fixed. If I can't bear the responsibility... then I should set the scissors down... and stop.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (Holds the girl's hands) Penny... You're wrong. You want to see it finished, don't you? If you quit now, it will never be finished.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: It won't be finished, but there will still be a future. Whether it's good or bad... I don't know, but it's enough. There's still time. He can still find someone else.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Jerry will regret this the rest of his life. All because you're giving up now, Penny.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: Right, it'll really weigh on him... but he won't be bound by our vows. He'll get better in the end... I hope he will.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Have you made up your mind?

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: Yes. Please help me. I... I can't bring myself to turn him down myself... and see him that sad.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Alright, Penny.
That night...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Darling, I have some bad news. Penny never wanted to see you finished.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Does she like you? Yes, she does. Does she want you, though? No, she doesn't.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Looks like I've wasted a lot of energy on something that I should never have gotten myself mixed up in.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I could finish you and keep you... and no one would know...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But what point is there in doing that?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Phew—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (Picks up the pair of scissors on the desk)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That's why... I'm sorry, my darling.

Under the moonlight, a cold ray of light is reflected on the pair of scissors held high. Just like a cruel, merciless bolt from the blue, it tears the beautiful wedding dress on the hanger asunder, splitting it into two halves.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I can't finish you.
Two weeks later...

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: No, how could you cut it up?!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I've already done it. Another glass of whisky, Joe? Thanks.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I really regretted doing this, especially when Jerry found out the next day that I didn't finish the dress.

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: Was he mad about it?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I wish he was, but he wasn't.

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: Did he say anything?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Not a thing. All he did was nod and leave.

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: Well, that sounds terrible.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You know what made it worse? Penny passed away on the day the wedding was supposed to be held. I didn't go to her funeral, because I didn't know if I could stand to look Jerry in the eye.

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: But that was over two weeks ago. Why are you here drowning your sorrows now?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Because Jerry paid me a visit this morning.

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: What did he say?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That he's leaving.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Before he left, he gave me a pair of scissors. He said it was a present Penny once gave him. He wanted to give them to me at the funeral, but I didn't show, and I'd been avoiding him since, so...

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: He had no choice but to drop in on you.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Sure enough. Hmm, this glass is all gone too. Get me another?

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: I think you're drinking a little too much.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You know how well I hold my liquor.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: When we said our goodbyes, I tried to comfort the boy and tell him to get back on his feet. It's what Penny would've wanted.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But he said to me...

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: But, Orchid... When the sun sets on someone, it doesn't matter how many stars there are in the sky. They can't help him out of this long night.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That filled me with regret. I shouldn't have cut the dress up. I should've pushed Penny to go ahead with the wedding. Then maybe Jerry would've felt better.

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: But you didn't do that.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Because I wanted to run away, again, and Penny gave me a good excuse to do it.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: The truth is, every moment I spent with Penny tormented me. I never felt so clearly just how life slips away from somebody, bit by bit.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (Trembling) It scares me... I tried to hold it in and to act normal in front of people.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But I can't help but wonder when I'm alone: What if that was me in the bed?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I have Oripathy, too!

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: (Holds Orchid's hand)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: So, once again, I crumbled. Once again, I ran away. Once again, I didn't see things through.

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: Another glass for you, Orchid?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (Raises glass)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: To Jerry and Penny, to dreams and failure, to that stinking old bastard Boyd...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: To life and death.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (Finishes in a single gulp)
